title: Agent tool definition (portable contract)
description: Portable core every harness can express. Platform-specific wrappers (OpenAI function format, MCP tool descriptors, host-native manifests) adapt around it via 'function' nesting or adapters; adapters must not weaken these checks.

granularity.description: micro=controlled risky ops; medium=normal loops; macro=merged hot workflows only. Macro never bypasses approval gates.

parameters.description: Input JSON Schema, root type object, narrow.

returns.description: Output shape the tool promises (observation contract recommended).

idempotent.description: Safe to re-run after unknown outcome?

allowed_paths.description: Path allowlist when the tool touches the filesystem.
